sections.title: Colour before the noun
sections.content: To say "a red T-shirt", put the colour before the noun: *piros póló*. The colour never changes. If you buy the thing, only the noun takes *-t*: *Egy piros pólót veszek.* After a number the noun stays singular: *két kék ing*. To ask what kind, use *milyen* before the noun: *Milyen inget kér?*

items.english: I would like a red T-shirt.
Anna is buying a green coat.
What kind of shirt would you like?

sections.content: The *-t* goes on the noun only: *piros pólót*, never *pirost pólót*. The colour word stays as it is.
